ana: Quick thread for APAC office hour follow-up after May webinar - logistics and ask list.

riley: Plan recap: single live session (10am PT) + 30m APAC office hour next day. APAC office hour = pre-recorded 10m demo + 20m live Q&A with regional host.

jun: Regional host suggestion: Mei from APAC campaigns team to moderate Q&A in Mandarin. she can co-host if we provide script + bullet answers.

emily: Confirming assets we need: 10m pre-recorded demo (EN), 1-pager host script for Mei (localized), localized CTA for RSVP to office hour.

ana (typo): *ana :) *

ana: RSVP gating idea: registration form asks "Would you like to join APAC office hour?" with timezone prefill. we'll auto-invite those who check it.

riley: Good. Also add hidden utm: office_hour=apac so we can segment followups. jun pls coordinate translation of host script.

jun: will translate host script + local Q&A prompts. need the demo transcript from zara by EOD.

emily: Ops question: do we run a separate small load test for APAC demo playback? want to validate CDN + playback links.

ops-bot: ops-bot: recommend smoke test of prerecorded via CDN 24h prior. will schedule if emily confirms URL.

ana: Emily will upload demo to drive and provide playback URL by tomorrow noon PT. jun will have translated script 24h after that.

riley: calendar: send APAC office hour invite only to RSVP list 48h before. calendar-bot can handle segmented invites.

calendar-bot: calendar-bot: provisional event "APAC Office Hour - Practical Inference Economics" 2024-05-16 02:00 PT created (private invites).

emily: final note - Mei prefers a 10min pre-call to align on Q&A tone. jun pls set a 15m prep call with Mei 48h before office hour.

jun: will schedule Mei prep call.

ana: thanks all - this will be short. closing thread, reopen if blockers.
